description: Module #46: a session started with --addon off never registers an add-on prefix, so the server must tell a real player once where to get the add-on. A (--addon off) gets one hint after entering the world - a whisper or a system line, the module's own text - and nothing again in the same session. HINT_RE is the module's stable line as the runner matches it: a ${var} in a match is matched literally, so give the exact text fragment, not a regexp. WAIT_S (90) is the bound it must arrive in (the expect step's timeout_s).

steps.title: the hint arrives once, inside the wait

steps.note: no kind: a whisper or a system line both count

steps.title: and not again in the same session

steps.note: once per character: the module must not repeat the hint
